mcqs.question: Which was the first state in India formed on linguistic grounds?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh was the first state in India formed on linguistic grounds.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Asia's first rubber dam was built on the Janjavathi.
Reason (R): Janjavathi is a tributary of the Nagavali.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: the Janjavathi hosted Asia's first rubber dam and is a tributary of the Nagavali. However, its tributary status does not explain why the dam was Asia's first.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Anantapur was the first place in Andhra Pradesh in iron production.
Erstwhile Nellore district was the first place in mica production and reserves.
Kadapa was the first place in limestone production and reserves.
Srikakulam was the first place in manganese production and reserves.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is the fourth one. Limestone production and reserves were associated with Kurnool, not Kadapa.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
(a) First asbestos production and reserves
(b) First limestone production and reserves
(c) First monazite production
(d) First gold mine in India identified

List-II
(i) Andhra Pradesh / East-coast belt
(ii) Kadapa
(iii) Kurnool
(iv) Andhra Pradesh
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are: asbestos—Kadapa; limestone—Kurnool; monazite—Andhra Pradesh/East-coast belt; gold mine identified—Andhra Pradesh.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Sri Venkateswara was the first bioreserve in Andhra Pradesh.
II. The Dolphin Conservation Society, Visakhapatnam, was associated with the first ex-situ biodiversity park of Andhra Pradesh.
III. Vani Vilasa Sagar, also known as Marikanive, was the first dam built by M. Visvesvaraya.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. Sri Venkateswara was the first bioreserve, the Dolphin Conservation Society at Visakhapatnam was associated with the first ex-situ biodiversity park, and Vani Vilasa Sagar/Marikanive was the first dam built by M. Visvesvaraya.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the boundaries of Andhra Pradesh.

List-I
(a) North
(b) East
(c) South
(d) West

List-II
(i) Karnataka
(ii) Bay of Bengal
(iii) Chhattisgarh and Odisha
(iv) Tamil Nadu
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh is bounded by Chhattisgarh and Odisha in the north, the Bay of Bengal in the east, Tamil Nadu in the south and Karnataka in the west.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Sileru River is associated with the AP–Chhattisgarh–Odisha tri-junction.
Reason (R): Sileru joins the Sabari at the tri-junction boundary of Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Odisha.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Sileru joins the Sabari at the tri-junction boundary, which explains its association with that tri-junction.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding Tammileru is incorrect?
options: Tammileru subsequently drains into Kolleru Lake.
Tammileru forms the boundary between Krishna and East Godavari districts.
Tammileru forms the boundary between Krishna and West Godavari districts.
Tammileru Dam was constructed on the river.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement alters West Godavari to East Godavari. Tammileru forms the boundary between Krishna and West Godavari districts.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Vedavathi rises from the Western Ghats.
Statement B: Vedavathi is also called Hagari in some parts of Andhra Pradesh.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true according to the notes. Vedavathi rises from the Western Ghats and is also called Hagari in some parts of Andhra Pradesh.

mcqs.question: Following the Pataskar Commission's decision in 1960, a large part of Tiruttani Taluka of Chittoor district was given to which state?
mcqs.explanation: In the 1960 Tiruttani/Tiruvallur territorial adjustment, a large part of Tiruttani Taluka of Chittoor district was given to Tamil Nadu.

3.title: Andhra Pradesh Rivers and River Features

mcqs.question: The Godavari River originates at which place?
mcqs.explanation: The Godavari originates at Triyambakeswar. Mahabaleshwar, Jayapur Hills and Nandidurga Hills are associated with the origins of the Krishna, Vamsadhara and Penna respectively.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Krishna River is incorrect?
options: The Krishna joins the Tungabhadra at Sangam in Kurnool district.
The Krishna originates at Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra.
The Krishna splits into two branches at Puligada, 64 km above Vijayawada.
The Krishna enters the Bay of Bengal at Hamsaladeevi.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is ‘above Vijayawada’. The Krishna splits into two branches at Puligada, 64 km below Vijayawada.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at Sangameswaram.
Reason (R): Sangameswaram is located in Kurnool district.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: the Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at Sangameswaram, and Sangameswaram is in Kurnool district. The location of Sangameswaram does not explain why the rivers join there.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Pinakini and Penneru are other names of the Penna.
Statement B: The Penna meets the sea at Pulicat Lake.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The Penna is also called Pinakini and Penneru, and its sea meeting is associated with Pulicat Lake.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The Vamsadhara originates in the Jayapur Hills of Odisha.
II. Langulya is another name of the Nagavali.
III. The Vamsadhara joins the Bay of Bengal at Mopasu Bandar.
IV. Janjavathi is associated with Asia's first rubber dam.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: Statements I, II and IV are correct. The Vamsadhara joins the Bay of Bengal at Kalingapatnam, not Mopasu Bandar; Mopasu Bandar is associated with the Nagavali.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
(a) Penna
(b) Vamsadhara
(c) Gosthani
(d) Gundlakamma

List-II
(i) Devarampadu village
(ii) Gandikota
(iii) Bheemunipatnam
(iv) Pathapatnam
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Penna–Gandikota, Vamsadhara–Pathapatnam, Gosthani–Bheemunipatnam and Gundlakamma–Devarampadu village.

mcqs.question: The Sabari River is also known by which name?
mcqs.explanation: The Sabari is also called the Kolab River. Langulya is another name for the Nagavali, Araniyar for the Arani, and Matsya Kundala for the Machkhand.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following are associated with the Machkhand River?
1. Origin in the Madugula Hills
2. Duduma Waterfalls
3. The name Matsya Kundala
4. Flow through Odisha
mcqs.explanation: All four are associated with the Machkhand: it originates in the Madugula Hills, has Duduma Waterfalls, is also called Matsya Kundala, and flows through Odisha.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Tammileru drains into Kolleru Lake.
Reason (R): The Tammileru forms the boundary between Krishna and West Godavari districts.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both A and R are true. The Tammileru drains into Kolleru Lake and forms the boundary between Krishna and West Godavari districts, but the boundary location does not explain its drainage into the lake.

mcqs.question: What was the historical name of the Swarnamukhi mentioned in the works of Dhurjati?
mcqs.explanation: The historical name of the Swarnamukhi in the works of Dhurjati is Mogaleru.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Gowthami branch
(b) Vashista branch
(c) Vinateya branch
(d) Tulya branch

List-II
(i) Bendamoorlanka
(ii) Yanam
(iii) Komarigiripatnam
(iv) Antarvedi
mcqs.explanation: The Gowthami branch joins the Bay of Bengal at Yanam, while the Vashista branch joins it at Antarvedi. The Vinateya branch has its mouth at Komarigiripatnam, and the Tulya branch is associated with Bendamoorlanka.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

I. The Godavari divides into seven branches in the erstwhile East Godavari and West Godavari districts.
II. The Godavari is 2.7 km wide at Rajahmundry.
III. Sir Arthur Cotton's dam on the Godavari is at Dhawaleswaram.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct: the Godavari divides into seven branches in the erstwhile East and West Godavari districts, is 2.7 km wide at Rajahmundry, and has Sir Arthur Cotton's dam at Dhawaleswaram.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

I. The Krishna flows through Kurnool district.
II. The Krishna flows through Guntur district.
III. The Krishna flows through Krishna district.
IV. The Srisailam Hydroelectric Power Station is on the Krishna River.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: The Krishna flows through Kurnool, Guntur and Krishna districts. The Srisailam Hydroelectric Power Station is also on the Krishna River.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Nagarjuna Sagar on the Krishna is near Nandikonda.
Statement B: Diviseema lies between the two branches of the Krishna.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Nagarjuna Sagar is near Nandikonda, and Diviseema lies between the two branches of the Krishna.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Hagari is the biggest tributary of the Tungabhadra.
Reason (R): Vedavathi, also called Hagari, is a tributary of the Tungabhadra.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true, but identifying Vedavathi as another name of Hagari and as a Tungabhadra tributary does not explain why Hagari is the biggest tributary.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Length of the Tungabhadra
(b) Biggest tributary of the Tungabhadra
(c) Vedavathi joins the Tungabhadra
(d) Vedavathi is also called

List-II
(i) Hagari
(ii) 531 km
(iii) Near Siruguppa
(iv) Hagari
mcqs.explanation: The Tungabhadra is 531 km long; Hagari is its biggest tributary. Vedavathi joins the Tungabhadra near Siruguppa and is also called Hagari.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Penna enters Andhra Pradesh
(b) Penna joins the Bay of Bengal
(c) Somasila Dam on the Penna
(d) Small delta formed by the Penna

List-II
(i) Nellore district
(ii) Anantapur district
(iii) Near Nellore
(iv) Vutukuru in Palnadu district
mcqs.explanation: The Penna enters Andhra Pradesh in Anantapur district and joins the Bay of Bengal at Vutukuru in Palnadu district. The Somasila Dam is near Nellore, and the Penna forms a small delta in Nellore district.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Vamsadhara is the biggest river born in the Eastern Ghats.
Reason (R): Mahendratanaya is a tributary of the Vamsadhara.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. The Vamsadhara is the biggest river born in the Eastern Ghats, and Mahendratanaya is its tributary; the tributary relationship does not explain the river's size distinction.

mcqs.question: The Bharadwaja branch of the Godavari is associated with which place?
mcqs.explanation: The Bharadwaja branch of the Godavari is associated with Bendamoorlanka.

mcqs.question: The Tungabhadra originates in which of the following?
options: Varaha Mountains of the Western Ghats
mcqs.explanation: The Tungabhadra originates in the Varaha Mountains of the Western Ghats.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Nagavali originates in the Rayagarh Hills of Odisha.
Statement B: The Nagavali enters Andhra Pradesh in Srikakulam district.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The Nagavali originates in the Rayagarh Hills of Odisha and enters Andhra Pradesh in Srikakulam district.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Machkhand initially flows northward.
Statement B: The Machkhand then flows eastward.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The Machkhand initially flows northward and then flows eastward.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Sabari's relation to the Sileru
(b) Origin of the Sileru
(c) Course of the Sileru
(d) Place where the Sileru joins the Sabari

List-II
(i) Tri-junction of Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Odisha
(ii) Tributary of the Sileru
(iii) Andhra Pradesh
(iv) Odisha
mcqs.explanation: The Sabari is a tributary of the Sileru; the Sileru originates in Andhra Pradesh, flows through Odisha, and joins the Sabari at the tri-junction of Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Odisha.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. The upper reaches of the Sileru are called Machkand.
II. The Sabari is a main tributary of the Godavari.
III. The Sabari originates in the Sinkaram Hill ranges of Odisha.
IV. The Sileru is a major tributary of the Sabari.
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct: the upper Sileru is called Machkand, while the Sabari is a main Godavari tributary originating in the Sinkaram Hill ranges; the Sileru is a major tributary of the Sabari.

mcqs.question: The Gundlakamma originates in which of the following?
options: Narayanavanam Protected Forest of Chittoor district
mcqs.explanation: The Gundlakamma originates in the Nallamala forests of Kurnool district.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the Arani:
I. It is 108 km long.
II. It originates at Sadasivakonda in the Narayanavanam Protected Forest of Chittoor district.
III. It flows southward and then eastward.
IV. It joins the south-western tip of Pulicat Lake.
mcqs.explanation: All four statements are correct. The Arani is 108 km long, originates at Sadasivakonda in Chittoor district, flows southward and then eastward, and joins the south-western tip of Pulicat Lake.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about the Champavathi are correct?
1. It originates near Andra village.
2. It joins the Bay of Bengal near Konada.
3. Eduvampula Gedda is its tributary.
4. Chitti Gedda is its tributary.
5. Pothula Gedda is its tributary.
mcqs.explanation: All five statements are correct. The Champavathi originates near Andra village, joins the Bay of Bengal near Konada, and has Eduvampula Gedda, Chitti Gedda and Pothula Gedda among its tributaries.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Gadi Gedda
(b) Denkada check dam
(c) Tarakarama Thirtha Sagaram
(d) Kumili Dam

List-II
(i) A tributary of the Champavathi
(ii) A check dam on the Champavathi near Saripalli in Vizianagaram
(iii) Another project on the Champavathi
(iv) Another project on the Champavathi
mcqs.explanation: Gadi Gedda is a tributary of the Champavathi. The Denkada check dam is on the Champavathi near Saripalli in Vizianagaram, while Tarakarama Thirtha Sagaram and Kumili Dam are other projects on the river.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Gosthani is an east-flowing river.
Reason (R): The Gosthani originates in the Anantagiri Hills of the Eastern Ghats.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: the Gosthani is east-flowing and originates in the Anantagiri Hills of the Eastern Ghats. However, its origin does not explain the stated direction of flow.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Gosthani is 120 km long.
Statement B: Three percent of Visakhapatnam district lies in the Gosthani basin.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: The Gosthani is 120 km long, and 3 percent of Visakhapatnam district lies in its basin.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The Tirumala temples are located in the Swarnamukhi basin.
Statement B: The Srikalahasthi temples are located in the Swarnamukhi basin.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Tirumala temples and the Srikalahasthi temples are located in the Swarnamukhi basin.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: The Kalyani Dam is on the Kalyani tributary of the Swarnamukhi.
The Kalyani Dam is associated with the Kalyani tributary.
The Kalyani is a tributary associated with the Kalyani Dam.
The Kalyani Dam is on the Kalyani tributary of the Gosthani.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is the second one. The Kalyani Dam is on the Kalyani tributary of the Swarnamukhi, not of the Gosthani.

mcqs.question: The Tammileru Dam is constructed on which of the following?
mcqs.explanation: The Tammileru Dam is constructed on the Tammileru.

mcqs.question: Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at which place?
mcqs.explanation: The notes state that Tungabhadra, the biggest and most important tributary of Krishna, joins Krishna at Sangameswaram in Kurnool.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Chitravathi is a tributary of Penna.
Chitravathi is formed by the confluence of Bahuda and Pancha.
Chitravathi joins Penna at Gandikota, Kadapa.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Chitravathi is formed by Bahuda and Pancha. The notes attribute this formation to Cheyyeru; Chitravathi joins Penna at Gandikota, Kadapa.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Janjavathi is an important tributary of Nagavali.
Reason (R): Asia's first rubber dam was built on Janjavathi.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are given in the notes. However, the construction of a rubber dam on Janjavathi does not explain its tributary relationship with Nagavali.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
(a) Vamsadhara
(b) Sabari
(c) Swarnamukhi
(d) Champavathi

List-II
(i) Gadi Gedda
(ii) Kalyani
(iii) Sileru
(iv) Mahendratanaya
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Vamsadhara–Mahendratanaya, Sabari–Sileru, Swarnamukhi–Kalyani, and Champavathi–Gadi Gedda.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Cheyyeru is formed by the confluence of Bahuda and Pancha.
II. Kundu joins Penna at Adinimmayapalli.
III. Papagni joins Penna at Gandikota, Kadapa.
mcqs.explanation: Statements I and II are correct. Papagni joins Penna near Kamalapuram, whereas Gandikota, Kadapa is the joining point given for Chitravathi.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following are listed as tributaries of Godavari?
1. Manjeera
2. Pranahita
3. Indravathi
4. Kinnerasani
mcqs.explanation: All four—Manjeera, Pranahita, Indravathi and Kinnerasani—are listed as tributaries of Godavari.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Sabari is a tributary of Godavari.
Statement B: Sileru is a tributary of Godavari.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are correct: Sabari and Sileru are listed as tributaries of Godavari.

mcqs.question: Into how many branches does the Godavari divide?
mcqs.explanation: The Godavari divides into seven branches.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Gowthami
(b) Vashista
(c) Vinateya
(d) Tulya

List-II
(i) Antarvedi
(ii) Yanam
(iii) Bendamoorlanka
(iv) Komarigiripatnam
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Gowthami–Yanam, Vashista–Antarvedi, Vinateya–Komarigiripatnam and Tulya–Bendamoorlanka.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Bharadwaja is a branch of Godavari located at Bendamoorlanka.
II. Koushika is a branch of Godavari located in the Kakinda or Coringa delta region.
III. Athreya is a branch of Godavari located at Coringa village.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. Bharadwaja is at Bendamoorlanka, Koushika is in the Kakinda or Coringa delta region, and Athreya is at Coringa village.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Hagari is the biggest tributary of Tungabhadra.
Reason (R): Hagari is a tributary of Tungabhadra.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both A and R are true. Hagari is identified as a tributary of Tungabhadra and as its biggest tributary, but the latter description is not explained merely by its being a tributary.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Cheyyeru is a tributary of Penna.
Statement B: Cheyyeru joins Penna at Gundlamada in Kadapa.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are correct. Cheyyeru is a tributary of Penna and joins it at Gundlamada in Kadapa.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following are tributaries of Champavathi?
1. Eduvampula Gedda
2. Chitti Gedda
3. Pothula Gedda
4. Vedavathi
mcqs.explanation: Eduvampula Gedda, Chitti Gedda and Pothula Gedda are tributaries of Champavathi. Vedavathi is a tributary of Tungabhadra, so the count is three.

mcqs.question: Kalyani Dam was constructed on which river?
mcqs.explanation: Kalyani Dam was constructed on Kalyani.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Sabari is the main tributary of Godavari.
Reason (R): Sileru is known as Machkand in its upper reaches.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: Sabari is the main tributary of Godavari, while Sileru is known as Machkand in its upper reaches. The name of Sileru in its upper reaches does not explain Sabari’s status as the main tributary.

5.title: Tribal Geography of Northern Hills and AP Regions

mcqs.question: Which one of the following tribe-location pairs is correctly matched?
options: Gadaba — Salur, Parvathipuram / northern border areas
mcqs.explanation: The notes associate the Gadaba tribe with Salur, Parvathipuram and northern border areas. Jatapu is associated with Srikakulam and Vizianagaram, Koya with the Godavari Valley, and Yanadi with Nellore and surrounding plains.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Bagata is associated with Visakhapatnam and Alluri Sitharama Raju districts.
Chenchu is associated with the Nallamala Forests.
Savara is associated with Nellore and the surrounding plains.
Konda Reddi is associated with the Godavari river banks and adjoining hills.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is the fourth one. Nellore and surrounding plains are associated with Yanadi, whereas Savara is associated with Srikakulam and Vizianagaram.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Chenchu is associated with the Nallamala Forests.
Reason (R): The Nallamala Forests region includes Palnadu, Prakasam, Nandyal and Kurnool.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true according to the notes. However, the listed districts of the Nallamala Forests describe the region and do not explain why Chenchu is associated with it.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Yanadi is associated with Nellore and surrounding plains.
Statement B: Sugali, Lambadi or Banjara is associated with Rayalaseema and central Andhra.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are directly given in the notes under Plains and Mixed Rural Areas. Yanadi is linked with Nellore and surrounding plains, while Sugali/Lambadi/Banjara is linked with Rayalaseema and central Andhra.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
I. Konda Dhora is associated with the Northern Eastern Ghats.
II. Kondh is associated with the Eastern Ghats–Odisha border.
III. Nakkala is associated with the Nallamala Forests.
mcqs.explanation: Statements I and II are correct. Nakkala is associated with plains and commercial areas, not the Nallamala Forests; therefore, only I and II are correct.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II.

List-I
(a) Bagata
(b) Jatapu
(c) Mukha Dhora / Nooka Dhora
(d) Porja

List-II
(i) Srikakulam, Vizianagaram

28.title: AP Rock Systems and Mineral Resources

mcqs.question: The Deccan Trap is characterised by which of the following?
options: Absence of fossils in the most ancient rock system
Lava outpouring through fissures during the Cretaceous
Formation of sandstone, shales and limestone
Transformation of ancient residual rocks into gneiss and schists
mcqs.explanation: The Deccan Trap was formed by lava outpouring through fissures during the Cretaceous.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Archaean Rock System is incorrect?
options: It is considered the most ancient rock system.
It is found in Srikakulam and parts of Eluru.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect detail is “contains fossils.” The notes state that the Archaean Rock System has no fossils.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): The Dharwar Rock System is associated with gneiss and schists.
Reason (R): The Dharwar Rock System consists of transformed ancient residual rocks.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are given in the notes: Dharwar consists of transformed ancient residual rocks and is associated with gneiss and schists. The reason does not specifically explain the association of those two rock types.
